title: Empires, trade and war
summary: The sector became a galaxy of 58 systems and six empires, with the Cycladic Isles as the newest. Every empire now builds its own stations and flies its own ships, and the Independents run free ports beside them, neutral in every war. Pledges and ranks gave way to a reputation with each empire, which missions, trade and bounties raise and attacks slowly lower. Stations got a commodities market, and both maps show the trade routes you know of. War fleets of 3 to 12 ships defend systems and invade enemy ones: besieged stations burn, offer repair and defence jobs, and can be destroyed for good. Your ship and your automaton gained gear in five qualities with damage types and resistances, and the planets gained environments. Generated systems now have 1 to 12 landable planets, some with moons. The interface was redesigned in amber, every key and gamepad button can be rebound, the settings fit the window in tabs, the maps take waypoints, and the Library became an asset browser. The game still runs at 240 FPS or more.

steps.title: A galaxy of 58 systems
steps.text: The sector grew into a galaxy. The 16 hand-made systems of the story stay as they were; around them every empire spreads outward to 6-12 systems of its own, each new system apart from the others, its gate lanes never crossing, named after the empire's further cities and islands. 58 systems, 88 lanes, 177 stations. Every generated system has 1 to 12 planets of the four landable types - volcanic near the star, ocean worlds in the middle, ice worlds and gas giants further out - and some have moons. Names never repeat.

diagram.text: 16 hand-made systems  ->  grown outward, empire by empire

steps.title: The Cycladic Isles
steps.text: A sixth star empire: the Cycladic Isles, island traders, quarrymen and sculptors of white marble and black obsidian, with Keros as their heartland. Their 12 ship classes and 12 stations were cut in from your painted sheets. They start as friends of the Minoans, Ionians and Athenians and wary of the Spartans and Mycenaeans.

diagram.label:
12 SHIPS
figurine · harpist · longboat
pan · obsidian · marble ...

12 STATIONS
colossal figurine · harbour
sanctuary · island beacon ...

steps.title: Every empire builds its own stations
steps.text: The empires used to share a handful of station designs, so an empire's station could look independent. Now each empire builds 12 stations of its own, made from prompts in the style of its ships: Minoan palaces and dolphins, the Athenian Parthenon and owls, Spartan lambdas and helmets, the Mycenaean Lion Gate and tholos domes, and the Cycladic designs. The old designs went to the Independents. Ships fly only their own empire's designs, and the home stations show their owner's colour (Kepler Outpost became Kephala Outpost).

diagram.text: 60 new station designs  ·  no design shared between owners

steps.title: Independents, and your reputation
steps.text: Ships and stations that belong to no empire are Independents: neutral with everyone, out of every war. The empire holding a system runs most of its stations, but free ports, an ally's outposts and an enemy's forward bases can sit beside them. You answer to no empire any more: pledges, merits and ranks are gone. Your standing with each empire rises with missions, trade and bounties, falls - slowly, a ship at a time - when you attack its ships, and fades back toward neutral. It sets prices, bounties and whether its warships attack you.

diagram.label:
a system: the owner's stations (most) + an independent free port
+ an ally's outpost or an enemy's forward base

steps.title: The commodities market
steps.text: The station market became a trading terminal: every good in a table by category, with sell and buy prices, the galactic average (and how far this station's price is from it), supply and demand bars and your cargo. Select a good to trade it, with a quantity picker, and to see the best places to sell it within 2 jumps - with the profit per unit and a button to plot the route. It works from the keyboard and a gamepad too.

steps.title: Trade routes on the maps
steps.text: Both maps gained a trade layer (T). The sector map shows the best runs from this system's stations; the galaxy map the ten best runs between systems, drawn along the gate lanes, with a goods filter and a list - click one to plot the route. Routes show only what you know: a run starts at a station whose market you've docked at and ends at a station you've seen. Being Friendly with an empire shares all of its markets.

diagram.text: Friendly with an empire: all its routes

steps.title: War fleets and sieges
steps.text: Every empire keeps fleets of 3 to 12 warships. Defence fleets hold its systems and go to the help of a besieged one nearby; at war, invasion fleets cross the lanes into the enemy's border systems. Away from you, battles and sieges are worked out in the background, with news; in your system the fleets are real ships, and you can join either side. An invasion with no defenders left besieges the enemy's stations until none of the owner's remain - then the system falls to the invader.

diagram.text: battle  ->  siege: stations lose health  ->  capture
a 10-ship siege burns a station in ~1.5 min

steps.title: Burning and destroyed stations
steps.text: A station's condition is its health. Below 40% it burns: fires break out across its sprite - charred hull, billowing smoke, tongues of flame cooling from yellow to deep red, a hot glow and embers - more and bigger the worse it gets. A burning station offers only two jobs: Repairs (bring materials; it mends the station and raises your standing) and Defend (destroy the besieger's warships). At zero it blows up and is gone for good. The story's home stations can burn but never fall.

diagram.label:
REPAIRS
bring machinery, ore,
energy cells or electronics
mends it · raises standing

DEFEND
destroy the besieger's
warships in this system

diagram.text: flames: scorch · smoke · tongues · glow · embers

steps.title: Gear for the ship and the automaton
steps.text: Equipment in five qualities, from E Common to A Masterwork: weapons, weapon mods, armour, cores and passives for your automaton on foot (a seven-slot loadout), and the outfitter's modules for your ship. They are bought at stations, dropped by ships, pirates and beasts, found in containers and won at signal sources. Damage now has a type - energy, kinetic, explosive, heat, cold - and gear brings resistances. Planets have environments too: volcanic heat halves your healing, ice slows your walking by 20%.

diagram.text: weapon · mod · mod · armour · core · passive · passive
volcanic: healing x0.5   ·   ice: walking x0.8

steps.title: The Helm interface
steps.text: The whole interface was redesigned in amber on smoked black glass, our own look: panels with two chamfered corners, bracket corners and a hatch of slanted ticks; buttons that rest dark with a lit rail and light up solid amber under the mouse; the selected tab lit; steel blue for data, shields and friendly things. About 95 hard-coded colours in 30 scripts were moved onto the palette. The old teal look is kept as a preset.

diagram.text: ~95 colours in 30 scripts onto one palette

steps.title: Keys, gamepad, settings that fit
steps.text: Every action can be rebound in Settings > Controls: two keys and a gamepad input each, clashes shown in red. Menus navigate with WASD, the arrows or the D-pad; Q and E switch tabs; Shift+D undocks. The gamepad flies the ship with the left stick, fires with RT and docks with Y. The settings are split into four tabs, and no menu is ever taller or wider than the window - a test opens every menu at 100% and 300% text to make sure. On the maps, Shift+click adds waypoints to your course and Shift+drag moves them.

diagram.label:
30 ACTIONS
key · alt key · gamepad
rebind: click, press

SETTINGS
DISPLAY · TEXT · SOUND · CONTROLS
always inside the window

steps.title: An asset browser, and still 240 FPS
steps.text: The Library became an asset browser: every asset of the game sorted by who it belongs to - each empire, the Independents, the Sea Peoples, you, monsters, wildlife, the galaxy and the interface - with a search box, cards and details; double-click opens the live room centred on it. A galaxy four times bigger needed speed: a price cache (the market table from 36 ms to 1.3 ms), a two-stage route search (138 ms to about 10), and the galaxy map's still layers drawn once into two pictures (1,589 draw calls down to 246). Every space scenario of the frame-rate tour runs at 240 FPS or more; the siege with a burning station at 416-503.

review.intro: A big patch, from one long session: the galaxy grown to 58 systems and six empires (the Cycladic Isles new), stations and ships in their owner's own art, the Independents, reputation in place of pledges, the commodities market and trade routes, war fleets with sieges and burning stations, gear with damage types, landable planets and moons in every system, the Helm interface, rebindable keys and the gamepad, settings that fit the window, waypoints, and the Library as an asset browser - with the speed-ups that keep a bigger galaxy at 240 FPS. The heart of it is in galaxy.gd (the simulation), main.gd (the space scene), station_menu.gd and the new scripts: fleets.gd, trade_routes.gd, market_page.gd, keybinds.gd and gear.gd.

The **Layers** panel turns routes, places, people and the grid on and off, and the planet's card sits in the corner.
 
 
 **Teleport gates** - glowing Minoan portal arches stand across every planet: one by the landing pad, one by every village and a few out in the wilds. Click one (walk up to it) and the **portal network** opens - the map with every gate on the planet, linked from the one you're at; click any other gate and you step out in front of it at once.

+(ionian_spacestations_1.png) - tools/extract_sprites.py cuts it by grid.
+
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+HOW TO USE
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ 1. Attach spartan_ships_1.png (the look) AND ionian_spacestations_1.png (the
+    layout, scale and camera) and send PROMPT A.
+ 2. Check it against the CHECKLIST; regenerate until it passes.
+ 3. Save it as external/images/spartan_spacestations_1.png and ask Claude to cut
+    it in: the cells map, row by row, to the keys in brackets below
+    (station_sparta_<key>), listed in tools/extract_sprites.py as SPARTA_STATIONS.
+
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+PROMPT A
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+Make a sprite sheet of 12 space stations in exactly the same style, scale, camera and layout as the attached station sheet: 1536 x 1024 pixels, pure black background, a 4 x 3 grid, each station centred in its cell with clear black space all round it (no part touching another cell), seen straight from above (top-down, roughly round or symmetric silhouettes that read well while slowly spinning), no text or labels. Give them the look of the attached Spartan ships:
+
+The Spartan Hegemony: a militarised star state where every citizen serves - fortress stations, few words, many guns. Heavy armour plating of deep crimson red and bone-cream panels over dark gunmetal grey, bronze and gold trim, hazard-stripe edges; emblems of the gold lambda (the Greek letter, an upside-down V) and the crested Corinthian helmet inside laurel wreaths, meander (Greek key) bands. Gun turrets and point-defence batteries everywhere, missile racks, armoured docking bays. Orange-amber engine and window glow. Angular, heavy, brutal shapes - octagonal plates, chevrons, wedges - never the Athenians' temples and owls, never the Minoans' curves and spirals.
+
+Row 1:
+1. A lambda fortress: a great gold lambda emblem on an octagonal armoured hub, three turreted arms.
+2. A helmet citadel: a hub shaped like a crested Corinthian helmet, crest of gun turrets.
+3. A hoplon: a giant round bronze shield with a lambda, its rim lined with gun batteries.
+4. A phalanx ring: a ring of overlapping round shields with spear-like cannons pointing out.
+
+Row 2:
+5. A citadel: a square-walled fortress with four corner towers and a central keep.
+6. An arsenal: a hub with racks of missiles and ammunition bays on four heavy arms.
+7. The agoge: a training ring of barracks and drill decks round a parade ground.
+8. Thermopylae: a gate fortress - two massive armoured walls closing a narrow docking pass.
+
+Row 3:
+9. A dory station: a cross of four long spear-shaped spars with bronze spear tips.
+10. Barracks: an octagonal block of hangars and crew quarters with hazard-striped landing pads.
+11. A war forge: a shipyard with a half-built warship hull held in heavy cradles.
+12. A watchtower: a tall sensor-mast hub with radar dishes and long-range guns on outriggers.
+
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+CHECKLIST
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+[ ] 1536 x 1024, black background, 4 columns x 3 rows, nothing crossing a cell
+[ ] top-down, symmetric enough to spin
+[ ] the Spartan ships' palette and signs (crimson, bone, gunmetal, bronze; lambda,
+    Corinthian helmet, laurels, meander; turrets everywhere)
+[ ] no text, numbers or watermarks
+[ ] all 12 clearly different

@@ -1,0 +1,312 @@ 
+class_name AssetBrowser
+extends PanelContainer
+## The Library's asset browser: every asset of the game (AssetCatalog), sorted
+## by who it belongs to. Left: a search box and a tree - each empire, the
+## Independents, the Sea Peoples, you, the monsters, the wildlife, the galaxy
+## and the interface, with their categories (Ships, Stations, Characters,
+## Buildings...) and counts. Middle: the chosen category (or the search's
+## hits) as thumbnail cards. Right: the selected asset - a big preview, what
+## it is, its file - and "View live", which opens the Library's live room
+## showing it (animated; planets, suns and nebulae editable there).
+## Double-click a card: view it live.
+
+signal view_live(room: String, spot: String)
+
+var _tree: Tree
+var _search: LineEdit
+var _head: Label
+var _grid: HFlowContainer
+var _scroll: ScrollContainer
+var _preview: TextureRect
+var _swatch: Control
+var _title: Label
+var _sub: Label
+var _info: Label
+var _file: Label
+var _live: Button
+var _sel := {}                      # the selected entry
+var _cur: Array = []                # the entries shown
+var _cards := {}                    # key -> card button
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UI.panel_style(Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.7)))
+	var m := MarginContainer.new()
+	for side in ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"]:
+		m.add_theme_constant_override("margin_" + side, 12)
+	add_child(m)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
+	m.add_child(row)
+
+	# Left: search and the owners' tree.
+	var left := VBoxContainer.new()
+	left.custom_minimum_size.x = 320
+	left.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	row.add_child(left)
+	_search = LineEdit.new()
+	_search.placeholder_text = "Search every asset..."
+	_search.clear_button_enabled = true
+	_search.text_changed.connect(func(_t): _show_search())
+	left.add_child(_search)
+	_tree = Tree.new()
+	_tree.hide_root = true
+	_tree.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_tree.item_selected.connect(_on_tree)
+	left.add_child(_tree)
+	var root := _tree.create_item()
+	var first: TreeItem = null
+	for o in AssetCatalog.owners():
+		var oi := _tree.create_item(root)
+		var n := 0
+		for c in o["categories"]:
+			n += c["entries"].size()
+		oi.set_text(0, "%s  (%d)" % [o["name"], n])
+		oi.set_custom_color(0, Color(o["color"]).lightened(0.25))
+		oi.set_metadata(0, {"owner": o})
+		oi.set_icon(0, _dot(o["color"]))
+		for c in o["categories"]:
+			var ci := _tree.create_item(oi)
+			ci.set_text(0, "%s  (%d)" % [c["name"], c["entries"].size()])
+			ci.set_metadata(0, {"owner": o, "category": c})
+			if first == null:
+				first = ci
+		oi.collapsed = o["id"] in ["wildlife", "galaxy"]
+
+	# Middle: the cards.
+	var mid := VBoxContainer.new()
+	mid.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	mid.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	row.add_child(mid)
+	_head = UI.label("", 20, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	_head.add_theme_font_override("font", NeonTheme.heavy_font())
+	mid.add_child(_head)
+	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
+	_scroll.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	mid.add_child(_scroll)
+	_grid = HFlowContainer.new()
+	_grid.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 10)
+	_grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 10)
+	_scroll.add_child(_grid)
+
+	# Right: the selected asset.
+	var right := VBoxContainer.new()
+	right.custom_minimum_size.x = 400
+	right.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
+	row.add_child(right)
+	var pv := PanelContainer.new()
+	var pvs := StyleBoxFlat.new()
+	pvs.bg_color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.55)
+	pvs.border_color = Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.35)
+	pvs.set_border_width_all(1)
+	pv.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", pvs)
+	pv.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(400, 320)
+	right.add_child(pv)
+	_preview = TextureRect.new()
+	_preview.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
+	_preview.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
+	_preview.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR
+	pv.add_child(_preview)
+	_swatch = _disc_control(Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
+	pv.add_child(_swatch)
+	_title = UI.label("", 22, Color.WHITE)
+	_title.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	right.add_child(_title)
+	_sub = UI.label("", 15, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	right.add_child(_sub)
+	_info = UI.label("", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_info.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	right.add_child(_info)
+	_file = UI.label("", 12, Color(UI.TEXT_DIM, 0.8))
+	_file.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_ARBITRARY
+	right.add_child(_file)
+	_live = UI.button("View live", _open_live, 17)
+	_live.custom_minimum_size.y = 42
+	_live.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("View live", "Double-click a card",
+		"Opens the Library's live room with this asset in it: animated as in the game - and planets, suns and nebulae editable there.")
+	right.add_child(_live)
+	if first:
+		first.select(0)
+		_on_tree()
+
+
+## A small coloured dot (the owners' tree).
+static func _dot(c: Color) -> Texture2D:
+	var img := Image.create(14, 14, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+	for y in 14:
+		for x in 14:
+			var d := Vector2(x - 6.5, y - 6.5).length()
+			img.set_pixel(x, y, Color(c, clampf(6.0 - d, 0.0, 1.0)))
+	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+
+
+## A shaded disc in a colour (procedural assets: planets, suns, nebulae, asteroids).
+static func _disc_control(c: Color) -> Control:
+	var d := Control.new()
+	d.set_meta("color", c)
+	d.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	d.draw.connect(func():
+		var col: Color = d.get_meta("color")
+		if col.a <= 0.0:
+			return
+		var r := minf(d.size.x, d.size.y) * 0.38
+		var ctr := d.size / 2.0
+		for i in 6:
+			d.draw_circle(ctr, r * (1.35 - i * 0.05), Color(col, 0.04))
+		d.draw_circle(ctr, r, col.darkened(0.45))
+		d.draw_circle(ctr - Vector2(r, r) * 0.2, r * 0.78, col)
+		d.draw_circle(ctr - Vector2(r, r) * 0.38, r * 0.3, col.lightened(0.3)))
+	return d
+
+
+func _on_tree() -> void:
+	var it := _tree.get_selected()
+	if it == null:
+		return
+	var md: Dictionary = it.get_metadata(0)
+	_search.text = ""
+	var entries := []
+	var head := ""
+	if md.has("category"):
+		entries = md["category"]["entries"]
+		head = "%s  ·  %s  (%d)" % [md["owner"]["name"].to_upper(), md["category"]["name"].to_upper(), entries.size()]
+	else:
+		for c in md["owner"]["categories"]:
+			entries.append_array(c["entries"])
+		head = "%s  ·  EVERYTHING  (%d)" % [md["owner"]["name"].to_upper(), entries.size()]
+	_show(entries, head)
+
+
+func _show_search() -> void:
+	var q := _search.text.strip_edges().to_lower()
+	if q == "":
+		_on_tree()
+		return
+	var hits := []
+	for t in AssetCatalog.all_entries():
+		var e: Dictionary = t[2]
+		if q in str(e["title"]).to_lower() or q in str(e["key"]).to_lower() or q in str(t[0]["name"]).to_lower():
+			hits.append(e)
+	_show(hits, "SEARCH  ·  \"%s\"  (%d)" % [_search.text.strip_edges(), hits.size()])
+
+
+## Shows these entries as cards (the first one selected).
+func _show(entries: Array, head: String) -> void:
+	_head.text = head
+	UI.clear(_grid)
+	_cards = {}
+	_cur = entries
+	for e in entries:
+		_grid.add_child(_card(e))
+	_scroll.scroll_vertical = 0
+	if not entries.is_empty():
+		select(entries[0])
+	else:
+		select({})
+
+
+func _card(e: Dictionary) -> Button:
+	var b := Button.new()
+	b.toggle_mode = true
+	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(160, 186)
+	b.tooltip_text = "%s\n%s" % [e["title"], e["info"]]
+	b.pressed.connect(func(): select(e))
+	b.gui_input.connect(func(ev):
+		if ev is InputEventMouseButton and ev.double_click and ev.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+			select(e)
+			_open_live())
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	v.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	v.offset_left = 6
+	v.offset_right = -6
+	v.offset_top = 6
+	v.offset_bottom = -6
+	v.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	b.add_child(v)
+	var tex := AssetCatalog.texture(e)
+	if tex:
+		var tr := TextureRect.new()
+		tr.texture = tex
+		tr.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
+		tr.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
+		tr.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(148, 132)
+		tr.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		v.add_child(tr)
+	else:
+		var d := _disc_control(e["swatch"] if e["swatch"].a > 0.0 else Color(0.4, 0.42, 0.5))
+		d.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(148, 132)
+		v.add_child(d)
+	var l := UI.label(e["title"], 13, Color.WHITE)
+	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	l.max_lines_visible = 2
+	l.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	v.add_child(l)
+	_cards[e["key"]] = b
+	return b
+
+
+## Selects an entry: its card lit, its preview and details on the right.
+func select(e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_sel = e
+	for k in _cards:
+		_cards[k].set_pressed_no_signal(not e.is_empty() and k == e["key"])
+	if e.is_empty():
+		_preview.texture = null
+		_swatch.set_meta("color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
+		_swatch.queue_redraw()
+		_title.text = "Nothing here"
+		_sub.text = ""
+		_info.text = ""
+		_file.text = ""
+		_live.disabled = true
+		return
+	var tex := AssetCatalog.texture(e)
+	_preview.texture = tex
+	_swatch.set_meta("color", e["swatch"] if tex == null else Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
+	_swatch.queue_redraw()
+	_title.text = e["title"]
+	var size_txt := ("  ·  %d x %d px" % [tex.get_width(), tex.get_height()]) if tex else ""
+	_sub.text = str(e["sub"]) + size_txt
+	_info.text = e["info"]
+	var t: String = e["tex"]
+	_file.text = t if t.begins_with("res://") else (("data/sprites/%s.png" % t) if t != "" and not t.begins_with("type:") else "")
+	_live.disabled = str(e["room"]) == ""
+	_live.text = "View live  ·  %s" % str(e["room"]).capitalize() if not _live.disabled else "No live room"
+
+
+func selected() -> Dictionary:
+	return _sel
+
+
+func _open_live() -> void:
+	if not _sel.is_empty() and str(_sel["room"]) != "":
+		view_live.emit(_sel["room"], _sel["spot"])
+
+
+## Shows a category by its owner id and name (tests, LiveLink).
+func open(owner_id: String, category := "") -> bool:
+	var it := _tree.get_root().get_first_child()
+	while it:
+		var md: Dictionary = it.get_metadata(0)
+		if md["owner"]["id"] == owner_id:
+			if category == "":
+				it.select(0)
+				_on_tree()
+				return true
+			var c := it.get_first_child()
+			while c:
+				if c.get_metadata(0)["category"]["name"] == category:
+					it.collapsed = false
+					c.select(0)
+					_on_tree()
+					return true
+				c = c.get_next()
+		it = it.get_next()
+	return false
+
+
+func shown() -> Array:
+	return _cur

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,218 @@ 
+class_name AssetCatalog
+extends RefCounted
+## Every asset of the game, sorted by who it belongs to - the Library's asset
+## browser (AssetBrowser) lists it. owners() returns, in order:
+##   [{id, name, color, categories: [{name, entries: [entry...]}]}]
+## and an entry is
+##   {title, sub, key (unique), tex (a res:// path or a ProcArt key; "" = none),
+##    swatch (a Color, for procedural assets drawn as a disc), info (text),
+##    room (the Library's live room showing it), spot (where in that room)}.
+## Empires (their ships, stations, people, buildings, effects), the
+## Independents, the Sea Peoples, you, the monsters, the wildlife, then the
+## galaxy itself (planets, suns, nebulae, asteroids, jump gates, terrain) and
+## the interface. Built once (cached); the textures load when shown.
+
+static var _cache: Array = []
+
+
+static func owners() -> Array:
+	if _cache.is_empty():
+		_cache = _build()
+	return _cache
+
+
+## Forget the catalog (after new art came in).
+static func reset() -> void:
+	_cache = []
+
+
+static func _owner(id: String, name: String, color: Color) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"id": id, "name": name, "color": color, "categories": []}
+
+
+static func _add(o: Dictionary, category: String, e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	for c in o["categories"]:
+		if c["name"] == category:
+			c["entries"].append(e)
+			return
+	o["categories"].append({"name": category, "entries": [e]})
+
+
+static func _e(title: String, key: String, tex := "", info := "", room := "", spot := "", sub := "") -> Dictionary:
+	return {"title": title, "sub": sub, "key": key, "tex": tex, "swatch": Color(0, 0, 0, 0), "info": info, "room": room, "spot": spot}
+
+
+## The sprite files of data/sprites starting with `prefix` (keys, sorted).
+static func sprite_keys(prefix: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var d := DirAccess.open(ProcArt.SPRITES)
+	if d == null:
+		return out
+	for f in d.get_files():
+		f = f.trim_suffix(".import").trim_suffix(".remap")
+		if f.begins_with(prefix) and f.ends_with(".png") and not out.has(f.trim_suffix(".png")):
+			out.append(f.trim_suffix(".png"))
+	out.sort()
+	return out
+
+
+## The first of these res:// paths that exists ("" if none).
+static func first_file(paths: Array) -> String:
+	for p in paths:
+		if ResourceLoader.exists(p):
+			return p
+	return ""
+
+
+static func _build() -> Array:
+	var by := {}
+	var order := ["minoa", "athens", "sparta", "mycenae", "ionia", "cyclades", "independent", "pirates", "player", "monsters", "wildlife", "galaxy", "interface"]
+	for e in ["minoa", "athens", "sparta", "mycenae", "ionia", "cyclades", "independent", "pirates"]:
+		by[e] = _owner(e, Galaxy.empire_name(e), Galaxy.empire_color(e))
+	by["player"] = _owner("player", "You, the pilot", Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.25))
+	by["monsters"] = _owner("monsters", "Monsters and bosses", Color(0.9, 0.35, 0.35))
+	by["wildlife"] = _owner("wildlife", "Wildlife", Color(0.55, 0.85, 0.45))
+	by["galaxy"] = _owner("galaxy", "The galaxy", Color(0.65, 0.75, 0.95))
+	by["interface"] = _owner("interface", "The interface", NeonTheme.CYAN)
+
+	# Ships: whoever flies the design (ShipDesigns.owner_of); the bosses apart.
+	by["player"]["categories"].append({"name": "Ship", "entries": [_e("Your ship", "ship:player", "ship_player", "The player's ship, as fitted at the start.", "SHIPS", "player")]})
+	var t := EnemyTypes.types()
+	var ids: Array = t.keys()
+	ids.sort()
+	for id in ids:
+		var d: Dictionary = t[id]
+		var info := "%s\nClass: %s  ·  hull %d  ·  shields %d  ·  speed %d%s\nLength in game: %d" % [d.get("desc", ""), str(d.get("class", "?")).capitalize(),
+			int(d.get("hull", 0)), int(d.get("shields", 0)), int(d.get("speed", 0)), ("  ·  %d cr" % int(d["price"])) if d.has("price") else "", int(d.get("length", 0))]
+		var e := _e(str(d.get("name", id)), "ship:" + id, "type:" + id, info, "SHIPS", id, str(d.get("role", d.get("class", ""))).capitalize())
+		if d.get("unique", false):
+			_add(by["monsters"], "Bosses", e)
+			continue
+		var o := ShipDesigns.owner_of(id)
+		if not by.has(o):
+			o = "independent"
+		_add(by[o], "Ships", e)
+
+	# Stations: StationArt.BY_EMPIRE.
+	for o in StationArt.BY_EMPIRE:
+		for dsg in StationArt.BY_EMPIRE[o]:
+			var info: Dictionary = StationArt.DESIGNS[dsg]
+			_add(by[o], "Stations", _e(info["name"], "station:" + dsg, "station_" + dsg,
+				"A %s station design (%s). Spins as in the game." % [Galaxy.EMPIRES.get(o, {}).get("short", o), dsg], "STATIONS", dsg))
+
+	# People.
+	var people := [["android_rifle", "Android rifleman", "minoa"], ["android_bow", "Android archer", "minoa"],
+		["android_axe", "Android with a labrys", "minoa"], ["guard", "Palace guard", "minoa"], ["kilon", "Kilon Alios", "minoa"],
+		["pirate", "Sea Peoples raider", "pirates"], ["player", "The pilot on foot", "player"]]
+	for p in people:
+		var path := first_file(["res://art/%s/%s_idle_s.png" % [p[0], p[0]], "res://art/%s/%s_aim_s.png" % [p[0], p[0]],
+			"res://art/%s/%s_walk_s_0.png" % [p[0], p[0]], "res://art/%s/%s_portrait.png" % [p[0], p[0]]])
+		_add(by[p[2]], "Characters", _e(p[1], "char:" + p[0], path, "Drawn in 8 directions (art/%s/): idle, walking, aiming." % p[0], "CHARACTERS"))
+	for k in sprite_keys("npc_minoan_"):
+		_add(by["minoa"], "Portraits", _e(k.trim_prefix("npc_minoan_").replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "npc:" + k, k, "A portrait for dialogue (data/sprites/%s.png)." % k, "CHARACTERS"))
+
+	# Minoan buildings: the tile styles' pieces, the furniture.
+	for k in sprite_keys("tile_palace_") + sprite_keys("tile_wh_") + sprite_keys("tile_xt_"):
+		var nm: String = str(k).trim_prefix("tile_")
+		_add(by["minoa"], "Buildings", _e(nm.replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "tile:" + nm, k, "A Minoan building piece (data/sprites/%s.png): walls, floors, roofs, columns, decor - the styles in MinoanTiles." % k, "BUILDINGS"))
+	var fd := DirAccess.open("res://art/furniture")
+	if fd:
+		var files: Array = Array(fd.get_files()).map(func(f): return str(f).trim_suffix(".import").trim_suffix(".remap")).filter(func(f): return str(f).ends_with(".png"))
+		var seen := {}
+		files.sort()
+		for f in files:
+			if seen.has(f):
+				continue
+			seen[f] = true
+			_add(by["minoa"], "Furniture", _e(f.trim_suffix(".png").replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "furn:" + f, "res://art/furniture/" + f, "Minoan furniture (art/furniture/%s)." % f, "BUILDINGS"))
+	# Effects: the androids' and the rifle's (Minoan arms).
+	for k in sprite_keys("fx_"):
+		_add(by["minoa"], "Effects", _e(k.trim_prefix("fx_").replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "fx:" + k, k, "An effect sprite (data/sprites/%s.png), drawn glowing." % k, "EFFECTS"))
+
+	# Monsters: the signal sites' creatures (their body sprite).
+	var monsters := {}
+	for k in sprite_keys("monster_"):
+		monsters[k.trim_prefix("monster_").get_slice("_", 0)] = true
+	for m in monsters:
+		var tex := ""
+		for cand in ["monster_%s_body" % m, "monster_%s_front" % m, "monster_%s_torso" % m, "monster_%s" % m]:
+			if ProcArt.has_sprite(cand):
+				tex = cand
+				break
+		_add(by["monsters"], "Creatures of myth", _e(str(m).capitalize(), "monster:" + m, tex, "A monster of the signal sites, rigged from its parts (data/sprites/monster_%s_*.png)." % m, "MONSTERS"))
+
+	# Wildlife by planet kind.
+	var kinds := {"fo": "Forest worlds", "ic": "Ice worlds", "vo": "Volcanic worlds"}
+	for k in sprite_keys("creature_"):
+		if not k.ends_with("_stand"):
+			continue
+		var id: String = str(k).trim_prefix("creature_").trim_suffix("_stand")
+		_add(by["wildlife"], kinds.get(id.get_slice("_", 0), "Others"), _e(id.get_slice("_", 1).capitalize(), "creature:" + id, k,
+			"Wildlife (data/sprites/creature_%s_*.png): standing, moving, acting." % id))
+
+	# The galaxy: procedural worlds (drawn as discs), gates, skies, terrain.
+	for tpl in PlanetGen.TEMPLATES:
+		var e := _e(PlanetGen.TEMPLATES[tpl]["name"], "planet:" + tpl, "", "A planet template (PlanetGen): every planet of the galaxy is one of these, mixed and recoloured.", "PLANETS", "", "Planet template")
+		e["swatch"] = _spec_color(PlanetGen.generate(tpl, 0))
+		_add(by["galaxy"], "Planets", e)
+	for tpl in StarGen.TEMPLATES:
+		var e := _e(StarGen.TEMPLATES[tpl]["name"], "star:" + tpl, "", "A star template (StarGen).", "SUNS", "", "Star")
+		e["swatch"] = _spec_color(StarGen.generate(tpl, 0))
+		_add(by["galaxy"], "Suns", e)
+	for tpl in NebulaGen.TEMPLATES:
+		var e := _e(NebulaGen.TEMPLATES[tpl]["name"], "nebula:" + tpl, "", "A nebula template (NebulaGen): the systems' backdrops.", "NEBULAE", "", "Nebula")
+		e["swatch"] = _spec_color(NebulaGen.generate(tpl, 0))
+		_add(by["galaxy"], "Nebulae", e)
+	for tpl in AsteroidGen.TEMPLATES:
+		var e := _e(AsteroidGen.TEMPLATES[tpl]["name"], "asteroid:" + tpl, "", "An asteroid template (AsteroidGen).", "ASTEROIDS", "", "Asteroid")
+		e["swatch"] = _spec_color(AsteroidGen.generate(tpl, 0))
+		_add(by["galaxy"], "Asteroids", e)
+	for k in sprite_keys("gate_"):
+		_add(by["galaxy"], "Jump gates", _e(k.trim_prefix("gate_").replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "gate:" + k, k, "A jump gate piece (data/sprites/%s.png)." % k))
+	for k in sprite_keys("sky_"):
+		_add(by["galaxy"], "Skies", _e(k.trim_prefix("sky_").replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "sky:" + k, k, "A planet's sky layer (data/sprites/%s.png)." % k))
+	var terrain := {"fo": "Terrain: forest", "ic": "Terrain: ice", "vo": "Terrain: volcanic", "gg": "Terrain: gas giant platforms"}
+	for pre in terrain:
+		for k in sprite_keys("tile_%s_" % pre):
+			_add(by["galaxy"], terrain[pre], _e(k.trim_prefix("tile_").replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "tile:" + k, k, "A terrain tile (data/sprites/%s.png)." % k))
+
+	by["interface"]["categories"].append({"name": "Widgets", "entries": [_e("The interface", "gui:board", "",
+		"Every kind of widget on a sample board; its look (colours, panels, corners, borders, glow) is edited live in the property panel.", "GUI", "", "Look and widgets")]})
+	var out := []
+	for o in order:
+		if not by[o]["categories"].is_empty():
+			out.append(by[o])
+	return out
+
+
+## A procedural spec's main colour (for its swatch).
+static func _spec_color(spec: Dictionary) -> Color:
+	for k in ["color_light", "color", "core", "main", "tint", "color_a", "glow"]:
+		if spec.get(k) is Color:
+			return spec[k]
+	for k in spec:
+		if spec[k] is Color:
+			return spec[k]
+	return Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.65)
+
+
+## The texture of an entry ("" -> null), loaded on demand.
+static func texture(e: Dictionary) -> Texture2D:
+	var t: String = e.get("tex", "")
+	if t == "":
+		return null
+	if t.begins_with("type:"):
+		return EnemyTypes.texture(t.trim_prefix("type:"))
+	if t.begins_with("res://"):
+		return load(t) as Texture2D if ResourceLoader.exists(t) else null
+	return ProcArt.get_tex(t)
+
+
+## Every entry, flattened: [[owner, category, entry]...].
+static func all_entries() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for o in owners():
+		for c in o["categories"]:
+			for e in c["entries"]:
+				out.append([o, c, e])
+	return out

files.explanation: New autoload: the war fleets. Every empire keeps defence fleets of 3-8 ships (one for three systems) and, at war, invasion fleets of 6-12 against enemy systems on its border. Away from you it's simulated every 5 s: fleets move along the gate lanes, fight, besiege and capture; in your system they're real ships.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,281 @@ 
+extends Node
+## War fleets (autoload "Fleets"): every empire keeps fleets of MIN_SIZE to
+## MAX_SIZE warships. Defence fleets hold its systems (about one for every
+## three), and go to the help of a system under siege nearby; at war, an
+## empire sends invasion fleets against the enemy systems on its border.
+##
+## Away from you it's all worked out here, every TICK seconds: fleets move
+## along the gate lanes (HOP_TIME a jump); where enemies meet they trade
+## losses; an invasion with no defenders left wears down the stations of the
+## empires it's at war with (Galaxy.damage_station) - destroyed at 0 - and
+## when the system's owner has no station left there, the system falls to
+## the invader (its fleet stays on to defend it). A peace sends invasions home.
+##
+## In the system you're in the fleets are real ships (main.gd spawns them,
+## and the ones arriving: fleet_arrived): defenders patrol, invaders go for
+## the stations; each ship lost counts (ship_lost). While you're there, that
+## system's fleets don't move and its fight isn't worked out here.
+
+signal fleet_arrived(fleet: Dictionary)
+signal changed
+
+const TICK := 5.0
+const HOP_TIME := 30.0
+const MIN_SIZE := 3
+const MAX_SIZE := 12
+## Station damage an invading ship does a tick (a 10-ship fleet: 6 a tick,
+## a healthy station falls in about a minute and a half of siege).
+const SIEGE_DAMAGE := 0.6
+## A station mends this much a tick when nobody besieges its system.
+const MEND := 0.4
+
+var fleets := {}   # id -> {id, empire, mission ("defend" / "invade"), size, system, route: [], t, target}
+var _next := 1
+var _t := TICK
+var _rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
+
+
+func reset() -> void:
+	fleets = {}
+	_next = 1
+	_rng.seed = 11
+	_t = TICK
+	_staff()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not Galaxy.active:
+		return
+	_t -= delta
+	if _t <= 0.0:
+		_t = TICK
+		_tick()
+
+
+func _tick() -> void:
+	_staff()
+	_move()
+	_fight()
+	_mend()
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+# --- Queries ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func in_system(sys_id: String) -> Array:
+	return fleets.values().filter(func(f): return f["system"] == sys_id)
+
+
+## Is this station's system besieged by an empire at war with its owner?
+func besieged(station_id: String) -> bool:
+	var st: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations.get(station_id, {})
+	if st.is_empty():
+		return false
+	var owner := Galaxy.station_owner(station_id)
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["system"] == st["system"] and f["mission"] == "invade" and f["route"].is_empty() and Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], owner):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## The empires besieging a system (for the defence missions).
+func besiegers(sys_id: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["system"] == sys_id and f["mission"] == "invade" and f["route"].is_empty() and not f["empire"] in out:
+			out.append(f["empire"])
+	return out
+
+
+func ship_lost(fleet_id: String) -> void:
+	var f: Dictionary = fleets.get(fleet_id, {})
+	if f.is_empty():
+		return
+	f["size"] -= 1
+	if f["size"] <= 0:
+		fleets.erase(fleet_id)
+		_news("%s: a %s %s fleet has been wiped out." % [Galaxy.system(f["system"]).get("name", "?"),
+			Galaxy.EMPIRES[f["empire"]]["short"], "invasion" if f["mission"] == "invade" else "defence"], "news")
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+# --- Fleets come and go ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _owned(e: String) -> Array:
+	return Galaxy.systems.keys().filter(func(id): return Galaxy.owner_of(id) == e)
+
+
+## Keeps every empire's defence fleets up (one for three systems) and, at war,
+## an invasion going against each enemy it borders.
+func _staff() -> void:
+	for e in Galaxy.MAJOR:
+		var own := _owned(e)
+		if own.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var mine: Array = fleets.values().filter(func(f): return f["empire"] == e)
+		var defenders := mine.filter(func(f): return f["mission"] == "defend").size()
+		if defenders < ceili(own.size() / 3.0):
+			var at: String = own[_rng.randi() % own.size()]
+			_new_fleet(e, "defend", at, _rng.randi_range(MIN_SIZE, 8), [])
+		for o in Galaxy.MAJOR:
+			if o == e or not Galaxy.at_war(e, o):
+				continue
+			if mine.any(func(f): return f["mission"] == "invade" and Galaxy.owner_of(f["target"]) == o):
+				continue
+			if _rng.randf() > 0.25:
+				continue   # (not every tick: invasions gather)
+			# An enemy system next to ours.
+			var fronts := []
+			for id in _owned(o):
+				if id == Galaxy.HOME:
+					continue   # (the story's home holds)
+				for n in Galaxy.neighbors(id):
+					if Galaxy.owner_of(n) == e:
+						fronts.append([n, id])
+						break
+			if fronts.is_empty():
+				continue
+			var pick: Array = fronts[_rng.randi() % fronts.size()]
+			var f := _new_fleet(e, "invade", pick[0], _rng.randi_range(6, MAX_SIZE), [pick[1]])
+			f["target"] = pick[1]
+			_news("%s: the %s gathers an invasion fleet of %d ships against %s." % [Galaxy.system(pick[0])["name"],
+				Galaxy.empire_name(e), f["size"], Galaxy.system(pick[1])["name"]], "danger" if pick[1] == Galaxy.current_system else "news")
+
+
+func _new_fleet(e: String, mission: String, at: String, size: int, route: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var id := "f%d" % _next
+	_next += 1
+	var f := {"id": id, "empire": e, "mission": mission, "size": clampi(size, MIN_SIZE, MAX_SIZE), "system": at,
+		"route": route.duplicate(), "t": 0.0, "target": at}
+	fleets[id] = f
+	if at == Galaxy.current_system:
+		fleet_arrived.emit(f)
+	return f
+
+
+# --- Moving ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _move() -> void:
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["system"] == Galaxy.current_system:
+			continue   # (in your system: real ships, they stay)
+		# A peace (or a target already taken) ends an invasion: home to defend.
+		if f["mission"] == "invade" and not Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], Galaxy.owner_of(f["target"])):
+			f["mission"] = "defend"
+			var own := _owned(f["empire"])
+			if not own.is_empty() and not f["system"] in own:
+				f["route"] = _path(f["system"], own[0], f["empire"])
+		# Defenders holding: go to the help of a besieged system of theirs within 3 jumps.
+		if f["mission"] == "defend" and f["route"].is_empty():
+			for g in fleets.values():
+				if g["mission"] == "invade" and g["route"].is_empty() and Galaxy.at_war(g["empire"], f["empire"]) \
+						and Galaxy.owner_of(g["system"]) == f["empire"]:
+					var p := _path(f["system"], g["system"], f["empire"])
+					if p.size() >= 1 and p.size() <= 3:
+						f["route"] = p
+						break
+		if f["route"].is_empty():
+			continue
+		f["t"] += TICK
+		if f["t"] < HOP_TIME:
+			continue
+		f["t"] = 0.0
+		f["system"] = f["route"].pop_front()
+		if f["system"] == Galaxy.current_system:
+			fleet_arrived.emit(f)
+			if f["mission"] == "invade" and f["route"].is_empty():
+				_news("An invasion fleet of the %s has arrived here: %d warships." % [Galaxy.empire_name(f["empire"]), f["size"]], "danger")
+
+
+## The way from a to b (the systems after a), through any systems.
+func _path(a: String, b: String, _e: String) -> Array:
+	var p := Galaxy.find_route(a, b)
+	return p.slice(1) if p.size() > 1 else []
+
+
+# --- Fighting (away from you) ----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _fight() -> void:
+	var by := {}
+	for f in fleets.values():
+		if f["route"].is_empty() and f["system"] != Galaxy.current_system:
+			if not by.has(f["system"]):
+				by[f["system"]] = []
+			by[f["system"]].append(f)
+	for sys_id in by:
+		var here: Array = by[sys_id]
+		for f in here:
+			if not fleets.has(f["id"]):
+				continue
+			var foes: Array = here.filter(func(g): return fleets.has(g["id"]) and Galaxy.at_war(g["empire"], f["empire"]))
+			if not foes.is_empty():
+				# A battle: losses by the other side's strength.
+				var strength := 0
+				for g in foes:
+					strength += g["size"]
+				var loss := int(_rng.randf() * 0.25 * strength + _rng.randf())
+				f["size"] -= loss
+				if f["size"] <= 0:
+					fleets.erase(f["id"])
+					_news("%s: the %s %s fleet was destroyed in battle." % [Galaxy.system(sys_id)["name"], Galaxy.EMPIRES[f["empire"]]["short"],
+						"invasion" if f["mission"] == "invade" else "defence"], "news")
+				continue
+			if f["mission"] != "invade":
+				continue
+			# A siege: the stations of the empires it's at war with.
+			var targets: Array = Galaxy.system(sys_id).get("stations", []).filter(func(sid): return Galaxy.at_war(f["empire"], Galaxy.station_owner(sid)))
+			if not targets.is_empty():
+				targets.sort_custom(func(a, b): return Galaxy.station_health(a) < Galaxy.station_health(b))
+				Galaxy.damage_station(targets[0], f["size"] * SIEGE_DAMAGE)
+				# Stations shoot back.
+				if _rng.randf() < 0.15:
+					f["size"] -= 1
+					if f["size"] <= 0:
+						fleets.erase(f["id"])
+				continue
+			_capture(sys_id, f)
+
+
+## No station of the owner left: the system falls to the invader.
+func _capture(sys_id: String, f: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var owner := Galaxy.owner_of(sys_id)
+	if owner == f["empire"] or not Galaxy.at_war(owner, f["empire"]):
+		f["mission"] = "defend"
+		return
+	if Galaxy.system(sys_id)["stations"].any(func(sid): return Galaxy.station_owner(sid) == owner):
+		return
+	Galaxy.systems[sys_id]["owner"] = f["empire"]
+	Galaxy.systems[sys_id]["control"] = 40.0
+	f["mission"] = "defend"
+	_news("CONQUEST: %s has fallen to the %s's invasion (taken from the %s)." % [Galaxy.system(sys_id)["name"], Galaxy.empire_name(f["empire"]), Galaxy.empire_name(owner)], "danger")
+	Galaxy.politics_changed.emit()
+
+
+func _mend() -> void:
+	for sid in Galaxy.stations:
+		var st: Dictionary = Galaxy.stations[sid]
+		if float(st.get("health", 100.0)) < 100.0 and not besieged(sid):
+			Galaxy.repair_station(sid, MEND)
+
+
+func _news(text: String, kind: String) -> void:
+	Galaxy._post(text, kind)
+
+
+# --- Saving ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func get_save_data() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"fleets": fleets.duplicate(true), "next": _next}
+
+
+func load_save_data(d: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if d.is_empty():
+		return
+	fleets = {}
+	for id in d.get("fleets", {}):
+		var f: Dictionary = d["fleets"][id]
+		f["size"] = int(f["size"])
+		f["t"] = float(f.get("t", 0.0))
+		f["route"] = Array(f.get("route", []))
+		fleets[id] = f
+	_next = int(d.get("next", fleets.size() + 1))
hunks.title: Fleets
hunks.note: A fleet is a small record - empire, mission, size, system, route. Each tick: keep the fleets staffed, move them a lane at a time, work out battles and sieges, and mend stations nobody besieges. While you're in a system its fleets stay put and its fight is played out by the real ships.

bubbles.text: Tops up each empire's defence fleets; at war, now and then gathers an invasion against an enemy system next to its own (never the story's home system).
A jump every HOP_TIME (30 s). A peace sends invasions home; idle defenders go to the help of a besieged system of theirs within 3 jumps.
Enemy fleets in one system trade losses by the other side's strength; an invasion with no defenders left damages the most damaged enemy station (SIEGE_DAMAGE a ship), and the stations shoot back.
When the owner has no station left in the system, it falls to the invader, whose fleet stays to defend it.
True while an enemy invasion sits in the station's system: no mending, no safe zone, crisis missions.

files.explanation: The galaxy's simulation grew the most in this patch: it grows 58 systems from the 16 hand-made ones, adds the Cycladic Isles and the Independents, gives every station its own owner, health and guests (free ports, allied outposts, forward bases), replaces pledges and merits with a reputation per empire, keeps a price cache for the market and the trade routes, and remembers which stations you have visited or seen.

+class_name Gear
+## Equipment: pieces you fit to your ship or equip on your automaton (you on
+## foot), each in a quality from E (common) to A (the best), which scales
+## what it does. Gear is an item like any other - "gear:<kind>:<quality>",
+## e.g. "gear:plasma_rifle:3" (a Plasma Rifle B): it sits in your hold or what
+## you carry (stacks of the same kind and quality), is bought at stations'
+## outfitters, dropped by ships, pirates and beasts, and won in encounters.
+##
+## Ship gear: Shipyard.MODULES (internal and utility slots - stat modules,
+## weapon modifiers, resistance plating, passives); fitted ones are the
+## player's `modules` [{id, rating}]. Ship weapons stay on the hardpoints.
+## Automaton gear: FOOT below, worn in the loadout (LOADOUT slots, the
+## player's "loadout" {slot: item id}).
+##
+## Damage has a type (DAMAGE_TYPES); resistances ("resist_<type>", a share
+## of that damage taken off, up to RESIST_CAP) come from gear and the tech
+## tree. Heat and cold resistance also offset a planet's environment
+## (Planets.environment: Akrotiri's heat, the ice moons' footing).
+
+const PREFIX := "gear:"
+const QUALITY := ["E", "D", "C", "B", "A"]
+const QUALITY_NAMES := ["Common", "Fine", "Superior", "Rare", "Masterwork"]
+const QUALITY_COLORS := [Color(0.75, 0.78, 0.82), Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.5), Color(0.4, 0.7, 1.0), Color(0.75, 0.5, 1.0), Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.25)]
+## What a step of quality does to an effect (the outfitters' ratings: Shipyard.RATING_MULT).
+const EFFECT_MULT := [1.0, 1.3, 1.65, 2.05, 2.5]
+## ... and to a weapon's damage.
+const WEAPON_MULT := [1.0, 1.15, 1.3, 1.45, 1.6]
+const PRICE_MULT := [1.0, 2.4, 5.5, 12.0, 26.0]
+## Selling gear back: this share of its price.
+const SELL_SHARE := 0.6
+
+const DAMAGE_TYPES := ["energy", "kinetic", "explosive", "heat", "cold"]
+const TYPE_NAMES := {"energy": "Energy", "kinetic": "Kinetic", "explosive": "Explosive", "heat": "Heat", "cold": "Cold"}
+const RESIST_CAP := 0.75
+
+## The automaton's loadout: its slots, and which kind of gear each takes.
+const LOADOUT := ["weapon", "mod1", "mod2", "armour", "core", "passive1", "passive2"]
+const SLOT_KIND := {"weapon": "weapon", "mod1": "mod", "mod2": "mod", "armour": "armour", "core": "core",
+	"passive1": "passive", "passive2": "passive"}
+const SLOT_NAMES := {"weapon": "Weapon", "mod1": "Weapon mod", "mod2": "Weapon mod", "armour": "Armour",
+	"core": "Core", "passive1": "Passive", "passive2": "Passive"}
+const DEFAULT_LOADOUT := {"weapon": "gear:laser_rifle:0"}
+
+## Automaton gear: kind -> {slot kind, name, price (quality E), desc, and
+## for weapons damage / interval (s) / range / type / bolt colour; for the
+## rest `effects` per quality step (times EFFECT_MULT)}.
+## Effect keys: max_hp (flat), damage_mult, fire_rate_mult (negative: faster),
+## range_mult, regen_mult, speed_mult, overcharge_mult, resist_<type>.
+const FOOT := {
+	"laser_rifle": {"slot": "weapon", "name": "Laser Rifle", "price": 300, "damage": 14.0, "interval": 0.22, "range": 700.0,
+		"type": "energy", "color": Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.2), "desc": "The automaton's standard rifle: quick laser bolts."},
+	"pulse_carbine": {"slot": "weapon", "name": "Pulse Carbine", "price": 500, "damage": 8.0, "interval": 0.11, "range": 560.0,
+		"type": "energy", "color": Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0), "desc": "A storm of light bolts, close in."},
+	"plasma_rifle": {"slot": "weapon", "name": "Plasma Rifle", "price": 800, "damage": 26.0, "interval": 0.38, "range": 650.0,
+		"type": "heat", "color": Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.15), "desc": "Slow, searing plasma: heat damage."},
+	"rail_rifle": {"slot": "weapon", "name": "Rail Rifle", "price": 1100, "damage": 44.0, "interval": 0.7, "range": 950.0,
+		"type": "kinetic", "color": Color(0.85, 0.9, 1.0), "desc": "A magnetic slug: the longest reach, the heaviest hit."},
+	"cryo_rifle": {"slot": "weapon", "name": "Cryo Rifle", "price": 900, "damage": 18.0, "interval": 0.28, "range": 680.0,
+		"type": "cold", "color": Color(0.6, 0.85, 1.0), "desc": "Freezing bolts: cold damage."},
+	"scope": {"slot": "mod", "name": "Long Scope", "price": 260, "effects": {"range_mult": 0.08},
+		"desc": "Weapon mod: more reach."},
+	"amplifier": {"slot": "mod", "name": "Bolt Amplifier", "price": 340, "effects": {"damage_mult": 0.07},
+		"desc": "Weapon mod: harder-hitting shots."},
+	"capacitor": {"slot": "mod", "name": "Rapid Capacitor", "price": 360, "effects": {"fire_rate_mult": -0.06},
+		"desc": "Weapon mod: shoots faster."},
+	"stabiliser": {"slot": "mod", "name": "Gyro Stabiliser", "price": 420, "effects": {"damage_mult": 0.04, "range_mult": 0.04},
+		"desc": "Weapon mod: steadier aim - a little more damage and reach."},
+	"bronze_plating": {"slot": "armour", "name": "Bronze Plating", "price": 300, "effects": {"max_hp": 14.0, "resist_kinetic": 0.04},
+		"desc": "Armour: more health, turns claws and slugs."},
+	"ceramic_carapace": {"slot": "armour", "name": "Ceramic Carapace", "price": 450, "effects": {"max_hp": 10.0, "resist_energy": 0.06, "resist_heat": 0.03},
+		"desc": "Armour: glazed ceramic that scatters laser bolts."},
+	"insulated_shell": {"slot": "armour", "name": "Insulated Shell", "price": 420, "effects": {"max_hp": 8.0, "resist_cold": 0.07, "resist_heat": 0.06},
+		"desc": "Armour: keeps out the cold of the ice and the heat of the magma."},
+	"blast_harness": {"slot": "armour", "name": "Blast Harness", "price": 400, "effects": {"max_hp": 12.0, "resist_explosive": 0.08},
+		"desc": "Armour: shrugs off blasts."},
+	"standard_core": {"slot": "core", "name": "Repair Core", "price": 300, "effects": {"regen_mult": 0.15},
+		"desc": "Core: you heal faster out of a fight."},
+	"servo_core": {"slot": "core", "name": "Servo Core", "price": 380, "effects": {"speed_mult": 0.05},
+		"desc": "Core: you walk faster."},
+	"fusion_core": {"slot": "core", "name": "Fusion Core", "price": 520, "effects": {"regen_mult": 0.08, "overcharge_mult": 0.15, "max_hp": 6.0},
+		"desc": "Core: energy cells overcharge longer; a little more health and healing."},
+	"med_injector": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Med Injector", "price": 280, "effects": {"regen_mult": 0.12},
+		"desc": "Passive: faster healing."},
+	"heat_sink": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Heat Sink", "price": 300, "effects": {"resist_heat": 0.08},
+		"desc": "Passive: heat resistance (and Akrotiri's heat wears on you less)."},
+	"thermal_lining": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Thermal Lining", "price": 300, "effects": {"resist_cold": 0.08},
+		"desc": "Passive: cold resistance (and the ice slows you less)."},
+	"targeting_ai": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Targeting AI", "price": 460, "effects": {"damage_mult": 0.03, "range_mult": 0.03},
+		"desc": "Passive: a little more damage and reach."},
+	"reinforced_frame": {"slot": "passive", "name": "Reinforced Frame", "price": 340, "effects": {"max_hp": 9.0},
+		"desc": "Passive: more health."},
+}
+
+
+# --- Item ids ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func item_id(kind: String, quality: int) -> String:
+	return "%s%s:%d" % [PREFIX, kind, clampi(quality, 0, QUALITY.size() - 1)]
+
+
+static func is_gear(id: String) -> bool:
+	return id.begins_with(PREFIX)
+
+
+## [kind, quality] of a gear item id, or [] if it isn't one (or unknown).
+static func parse(id: String) -> Array:
+	if not is_gear(id):
+		return []
+	var parts := id.substr(PREFIX.length()).split(":")
+	if parts.size() != 2 or not (FOOT.has(parts[0]) or Shipyard.MODULES.has(parts[0])):
+		return []
+	return [parts[0], clampi(int(parts[1]), 0, QUALITY.size() - 1)]
+
+
+## "ship" or "foot" (or "" if it isn't gear).
+static func side(id: String) -> String:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return ""
+	return "foot" if FOOT.has(p[0]) else "ship"
+
+
+## The catalogue entry of a gear item's kind ({} if none).
+static func entry(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if p.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	return FOOT[p[0]] if FOOT.has(p[0]) else Shipyard.MODULES[p[0]]
+
+
+## Its slot: automaton "weapon" / "mod" / "armour" / "core" / "passive", ship "internal" / "utility".
+static func slot_of(id: String) -> String:
+	return str(entry(id).get("slot", ""))
+
+
+static func quality(id: String) -> int:
+	var p := parse(id)
+	return p[1] if not p.is_empty() else 0
+
+
+static func title(id: String) -> String:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	return "%s %s" % [e.get("name", id), QUALITY[quality(id)]] if not e.is_empty() else id
+
+
+static func price(id: String) -> int:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	return roundi(float(e.get("price", 0)) * PRICE_MULT[quality(id)])
+
+
+## Its effects at its quality.
+static func effects(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	var out := {}
+	var m: float = EFFECT_MULT[quality(id)]
+	for k in e.get("effects", {}):
+		out[k] = float(e["effects"][k]) * m
+	return out
+
+
+## An automaton weapon's stats at its quality: {damage, interval, range, type, color}.
+static func weapon_stats(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.get("slot", "") != "weapon":
+		e = FOOT["laser_rifle"]
+	return {"damage": float(e["damage"]) * WEAPON_MULT[quality(id)], "interval": float(e["interval"]),
+		"range": float(e["range"]), "type": str(e["type"]), "color": e["color"]}
+
+
+## Items-style info for a gear item (Items.info): name, kind "gear", value, price, desc.
+static func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	return {"name": title(id), "kind": "gear", "value": roundi(price(id) * SELL_SHARE), "price": price(id),
+		"desc": "%s %s gear (%s). %s %s" % [QUALITY_NAMES[quality(id)], "automaton" if side(id) == "foot" else "ship",
+			_slot_label(id), e.get("desc", ""), describe(id)]}
+
+
+static func _slot_label(id: String) -> String:
+	var s := slot_of(id)
+	return {"weapon": "weapon", "mod": "weapon mod", "armour": "armour", "core": "core", "passive": "passive",
+		"internal": "internal slot", "utility": "utility slot"}.get(s, s)
+
+
+## What it does, in words ("+14 health, +4% kinetic resistance").
+static func describe(id: String) -> String:
+	var parts := []
+	if slot_of(id) == "weapon" and side(id) == "foot":
+		var w := weapon_stats(id)
+		parts.append("%.0f %s damage, %.1f shots/s, reach %.0f" % [w["damage"], TYPE_NAMES[w["type"]].to_lower(), 1.0 / w["interval"], w["range"]])
+	var fx := effects(id)
+	for k in fx:
+		parts.append(effect_text(k, fx[k]))
+	return ", ".join(parts)
+
+
+static func effect_text(key: String, v: float) -> String:
+	if key.begins_with("resist_"):
+		return "+%d%% %s resistance" % [roundi(v * 100.0), key.trim_prefix("resist_")]
+	match key:
+		"max_hp": return "+%.0f health" % v
+		"max_hull": return "+%.0f hull" % v
+		"max_shields": return "+%.0f shields" % v
+		"hull_regen": return "+%.1f hull/s" % v
+		"cargo": return "+%d hold slots" % roundi(v / Shipyard.RACK_UNITS_PER_SLOT)
+		"fire_rate_mult": return "+%d%% fire rate" % roundi(-v * 100.0)
+	var label: String = {"damage_mult": "damage", "range_mult": "reach", "regen_mult": "healing", "speed_mult": "speed",
+		"overcharge_mult": "overcharge time", "shield_regen_mult": "shield recharge", "handling_mult": "handling"}.get(key, key)
+	return "+%d%% %s" % [roundi(v * 100.0), label]
+
+
+# --- The automaton's loadout ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The player's loadout (the save format's "loadout": {slot: item id}), made if missing.
+static func loadout(player: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	if not player.get("loadout") is Dictionary:
+		player["loadout"] = DEFAULT_LOADOUT.duplicate()
+	return player["loadout"]
+
+
+## Whether gear item `id` goes in loadout slot `slot`.
+static func fits(id: String, slot: String) -> bool:
+	return side(id) == "foot" and SLOT_KIND.get(slot, "") == slot_of(id)
+
+
+## The summed effects of a loadout (weapon included).
+static func loadout_effects(lo: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var total := {}
+	for s in LOADOUT:
+		var id := str(lo.get(s, ""))
+		if id == "":
+			continue
+		var fx := effects(id)
+		for k in fx:
+			total[k] = float(total.get(k, 0.0)) + fx[k]
+	return total
+
+
+## Equips gear item `id` from inventory `inv` into slot `slot` of loadout
+## `lo`; what was there goes back into `inv` (it needs room: `cap` slots).
+## True if done.
+static func equip(lo: Dictionary, inv: Dictionary, cap: int, id: String, slot: String) -> bool:
+	if not fits(id, slot) or int(inv.get(id, 0)) <= 0:
+		return false
+	var old := str(lo.get(slot, ""))
+	Inventory.take(inv, id, 1)
+	if old != "" and Inventory.add(inv, old, 1, cap) < 1:
+		Inventory.add(inv, id, 1, cap + 1)   # (no room for the old one: undone)
+		return false
+	lo[slot] = id
+	return true
+
+
+## The slot a piece of gear would go in: the first empty one that takes it,
+## else the first that takes it ("" if none).
+static func slot_for(lo: Dictionary, id: String) -> String:
+	var first := ""
+	for s in LOADOUT:
+		if fits(id, s):
+			if str(lo.get(s, "")) == "":
+				return s
+			if first == "":
+				first = s
+	return first
+
+
+## Takes off what's in slot `slot` of loadout `lo` into `inv`. True if done
+## (the weapon slot is never left empty: the standard rifle goes back in).
+static func unequip(lo: Dictionary, inv: Dictionary, cap: int, slot: String) -> bool:
+	var old := str(lo.get(slot, ""))
+	if old == "" or (slot == "weapon" and old == DEFAULT_LOADOUT["weapon"]):
+		return false
+	if Inventory.add(inv, old, 1, cap) < 1:
+		return false
+	if slot == "weapon":
+		lo[slot] = DEFAULT_LOADOUT["weapon"]
+	else:
+		lo.erase(slot)
+	return true
+
+
+# --- Ship gear ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Fits ship gear item `id` from the hold: true if it had a free slot.
+static func fit(data: Node, id: String) -> bool:
+	if side(id) != "ship" or data.count(id) <= 0:
+		return false
+	var p := parse(id)
+	if Shipyard.free_slots(data, slot_of(id)) <= 0:
+		return false
+	Inventory.take(data.items, id, 1)
+	data.modules.append({"id": p[0], "rating": p[1]})
+	return true
+
+
+## Takes fitted module `i` out into the hold: true if there was room.
+static func unfit(data: Node, i: int) -> bool:
+	if i < 0 or i >= data.modules.size():
+		return false
+	var m: Dictionary = data.modules[i]
+	var id := item_id(m["id"], int(m["rating"]))
+	if Inventory.room_for(data.items, id, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data)) < 1:
+		return false
+	Inventory.add(data.items, id, 1, Shipyard.cargo_capacity(data))
+	data.modules.remove_at(i)
+	return true
+
+
+# --- Where gear comes from ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A random piece of gear: `side` "ship" / "foot" / "" (either); `level` 0..1
+## (how tough what dropped it was: the better, the likelier a high quality).
+static func roll(rng: RandomNumberGenerator, side_ := "", level := 0.3) -> String:
+	var s := side_ if side_ != "" else ("ship" if rng.randf() < 0.5 else "foot")
+	var kinds: Array = FOOT.keys() if s == "foot" else Shipyard.MODULES.keys()
+	var kind: String = kinds[rng.randi() % kinds.size()]
+	# Quality: mostly E-C; the tougher the source, the more B and A.
+	var r := rng.randf() + clampf(level, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.55
+	var q := 0
+	for t in [0.55, 0.85, 1.12, 1.38]:
+		if r > t:
+			q += 1
+	return item_id(kind, q)
+
+
+# --- Icons --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A gear item's icon: a glyph for its slot in a ring of its quality's colour.
+static func draw_icon(ci: CanvasItem, id: String, rect: Rect2, dim := false) -> void:
+	var c := rect.get_center()
+	var r := minf(rect.size.x, rect.size.y) * 0.5
+	var qc: Color = QUALITY_COLORS[quality(id)]
+	if dim:
+		qc = qc.darkened(0.5)
+	ci.draw_arc(c, r * 0.92, 0, TAU, 32, Color(qc, 0.9), maxf(1.5, r * 0.08), true)
+	var g := Color(0.92, 0.94, 1.0) if not dim else Color(0.5, 0.52, 0.56)
+	var w := maxf(1.5, r * 0.1)
+	match slot_of(id):
+		"weapon":
+			ci.draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.6, r * 0.25), c + Vector2(r * 0.6, -r * 0.25), g, w * 1.6, true)
+			ci.draw_line(c + Vector2(-r * 0.2, r * 0.1), c + Vector2(-r * 0.3, r * 0.5), g, w, true)
+		"mod":
+			for k in 6:
+				var a := TAU * k / 6.0
+				ci.draw_line(c + Vector2.from_angle(a) * r * 0.25, c + Vector2.from_angle(a) * r * 0.55, g, w, true)
+			ci.draw_arc(c, r * 0.25, 0, TAU, 16, g, w, true)
+		"armour", "internal":
+			ci.draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(-r * 0.5, -r * 0.45), c + Vector2(r * 0.5, -r * 0.45),
+				c + Vector2(r * 0.45, r * 0.15), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.6), c + Vector2(-r * 0.45, r * 0.15), c + Vector2(-r * 0.5, -r * 0.45)]), g, w, true)
+		"core":
+			ci.draw_arc(c, r * 0.45, 0, TAU, 20, g, w, true)
+			ci.draw_circle(c, r * 0.18, Color(qc, 0.9))
+		_:   # passive, utility
+			ci.draw_polyline(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.55), c + Vector2(r * 0.5, 0), c + Vector2(0, r * 0.55),
+				c + Vector2(-r * 0.5, 0), c + Vector2(0, -r * 0.55)]), g, w, true)
+	ci.draw_string(ThemeDB.fallback_font, rect.position + Vector2(rect.size.x - r * 0.55, r * 0.55), QUALITY[quality(id)],
+		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, maxi(9, int(r * 0.42)), qc)

files.explanation: New autoload: every action's keys and gamepad input in one place - registered in the InputMap, rebindable in Settings, saved; menu navigation with WASD / arrows / D-pad / stick and tab switching.

@@ -1,0 +1,380 @@ 
+extends Node
+## Every rebindable control (autoload "Keybinds"): its default keys and
+## gamepad button, the player's own choices (Settings > Controls, saved in
+## user://keybinds.cfg), all registered in Godot's InputMap so the game asks
+## `Keybinds.pressed(event, "dock")` instead of naming a key.
+##
+## Each action has three slots: two keys and one gamepad input ("" = none).
+## A slot is written "k:<key name>" (OS.get_keycode_string - with its
+## modifiers: "k:Shift+D"; a key with modifiers matches only with exactly
+## those held, a plain key only with none), "p:<joypad
+## button>" or "a:<axis><+|->" (a stick or trigger pushed that way).
+## The menu actions also feed Godot's own ui_* actions (Enter / pad A press a
+## focused button, the arrows / D-pad move the focus), so every menu built of
+## focusable controls gets keyboard and gamepad navigation.
+##
+## Menu navigation (this node, last in line for unhandled input): when a game
+## menu that registered with register_menu() is open, the menu direction
+## actions (WASD as well as the arrows / D-pad / left stick) move the focus
+## between its controls - the first press focuses its first control - and
+## menu_tab_prev / menu_tab_next switch its tabs (the menu's cycle_tab(dir)).
+##
+## The gamepad in flight (main.gd / planet_surface.gd read it): the left stick
+## steers (stick_vector()), the other actions are ordinary bindings.
+
+signal changed
+
+const FILE := "user://keybinds.cfg"
+const DEADZONE := 0.3
+
+## [id, group, label, [key 1, key 2, pad]]
+const ACTIONS := [
+	["menu_up", "Menus", "Up", ["k:W", "k:Up", "p:11"]],
+	["menu_down", "Menus", "Down", ["k:S", "k:Down", "p:12"]],
+	["menu_left", "Menus", "Left / less", ["k:A", "k:Left", "p:13"]],
+	["menu_right", "Menus", "Right / more", ["k:D", "k:Right", "p:14"]],
+	["menu_accept", "Menus", "Select / buy", ["k:Enter", "k:Space", "p:0"]],
+	["menu_secondary", "Menus", "Secondary action / sell", ["k:Backspace", "", "p:2"]],
+	["menu_back", "Menus", "Back / close", ["k:Escape", "", "p:1"]],
+	["menu_tab_prev", "Menus", "Previous tab", ["k:Q", "", "p:9"]],
+	["menu_tab_next", "Menus", "Next tab", ["k:E", "", "p:10"]],
+	["undock", "Menus", "Undock (station)", ["k:Shift+D", "", "p:3"]],
+	["pause", "Flight", "Pause menu", ["k:Escape", "", "p:6"]],
+	["computer", "Flight", "Ship computer / field menu", ["k:Tab", "", "p:4"]],
+	["inventory", "Flight", "Inventory", ["k:I", "", ""]],
+	["sector_map", "Flight", "Sector map", ["k:M", "", ""]],
+	["galaxy_map", "Flight", "Galaxy map", ["k:G", "", ""]],
+	["dock", "Flight", "Dock / undock", ["k:E", "", "p:3"]],
+	["attack", "Flight", "Attack the nearest enemy", ["k:F", "", "a:5+"]],
+	["trade_layer", "Flight", "Trade routes on the maps", ["k:T", "", "p:8"]],
+	["hail", "Flight", "Hail a ship", ["k:H", "", ""]],
+	["event_log", "Flight", "Event log", ["k:L", "", ""]],
+	["slot_prev", "Flight", "Previous weapon / tool", ["", "", "p:9"]],
+	["slot_next", "Flight", "Next weapon / tool", ["", "", "p:10"]],
+	["slot_1", "Toolbar", "Slot 1", ["k:1", "", ""]],
+	["slot_2", "Toolbar", "Slot 2", ["k:2", "", ""]],
+	["slot_3", "Toolbar", "Slot 3", ["k:3", "", ""]],
+	["slot_4", "Toolbar", "Slot 4", ["k:4", "", ""]],
+	["slot_5", "Toolbar", "Slot 5", ["k:5", "", ""]],
+	["slot_6", "Toolbar", "Slot 6", ["k:6", "", ""]],
+	["slot_7", "Toolbar", "Slot 7", ["k:7", "", ""]],
+	["slot_8", "Toolbar", "Slot 8", ["k:8", "", ""]],
+	["slot_9", "Toolbar", "Slot 9", ["k:9", "", ""]],
+]
+## The menu actions that also drive Godot's ui_* (focus, buttons).
+const UI_MIRROR := {"menu_accept": "ui_accept", "menu_back": "ui_cancel"}
+## Left stick on the menu directions (always, besides the three slots).
+const STICK := {"menu_up": "a:1-", "menu_down": "a:1+", "menu_left": "a:0-", "menu_right": "a:0+"}
+
+var binds := {}          # id -> [3 slot strings]
+var _menus: Array = []   # registered game menus (Controls), see register_menu
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS   # (menus run with the game paused)
+	load_binds()
+
+
+# --- The bindings -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func defaults(id: String) -> Array:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] == id:
+			return a[3].duplicate()
+	return ["", "", ""]
+
+
+static func label(id: String) -> String:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] == id:
+			return a[2]
+	return id
+
+
+func load_binds() -> void:
+	binds = {}
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		binds[a[0]] = a[3].duplicate()
+	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
+	if cfg.load(FILE) == OK:
+		for id in binds:
+			var v = cfg.get_value("binds", id) if cfg.has_section_key("binds", id) else null
+			if v is Array and v.size() == 3:
+				binds[id] = v.map(func(s): return str(s))
+	_apply()
+
+
+func save_binds() -> void:
+	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
+	for id in binds:
+		if binds[id] != defaults(id):
+			cfg.set_value("binds", id, binds[id])
+	cfg.save(FILE)
+
+
+## Bind `slot` (0, 1: keys; 2: pad) of `id` to `spec` ("" clears it).
+func set_bind(id: String, slot: int, spec: String) -> void:
+	binds[id][slot] = spec
+	_apply()
+	save_binds()
+
+
+func reset(id := "") -> void:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if id == "" or a[0] == id:
+			binds[a[0]] = a[3].duplicate()
+	_apply()
+	save_binds()
+
+
+## Other actions of the same group using `spec` (a clash to point out).
+func clashes(id: String, spec: String) -> Array:
+	if spec == "":
+		return []
+	var group := ""
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] == id:
+			group = a[1]
+	var out := []
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		if a[0] != id and spec in binds[a[0]] and (a[1] == group or (group != "Menus" and a[1] != "Menus")):
+			out.append(a[0])
+	return out
+
+
+## Puts every binding into the InputMap (and the ui_* mirrors).
+func _apply() -> void:
+	for a in ACTIONS:
+		var id: String = a[0]
+		if InputMap.has_action(id):
+			InputMap.action_erase_events(id)
+		else:
+			InputMap.add_action(id, 0.5)
+		var specs: Array = binds[id].duplicate()
+		if STICK.has(id):
+			specs.append(STICK[id])
+		for s in specs:
+			var ev := to_event(s)
+			if ev:
+				InputMap.action_add_event(id, ev)
+	for id in UI_MIRROR:
+		var ui: String = UI_MIRROR[id]
+		# ui_accept keeps its own Enter / Space; add ours (pad A, a rebound key).
+		for s in binds[id]:
+			var ev := to_event(s)
+			if ev and not InputMap.action_has_event(ui, ev):
+				InputMap.action_add_event(ui, ev)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+static func to_event(spec: String) -> InputEvent:
+	if spec.length() < 3:
+		return null
+	var v := spec.substr(2)
+	match spec[0]:
+		"k":
+			var code := OS.find_keycode_from_string(v)
+			if code & KEY_CODE_MASK == KEY_NONE:
+				return null
+			var k := InputEventKey.new()
+			k.keycode = code & KEY_CODE_MASK
+			k.shift_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_SHIFT != 0
+			k.ctrl_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_CTRL != 0
+			k.alt_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_ALT != 0
+			k.meta_pressed = code & KEY_MASK_META != 0
+			return k
+		"p":
+			var b := InputEventJoypadButton.new()
+			b.button_index = int(v) as JoyButton
+			return b
+		"a":
+			var m := InputEventJoypadMotion.new()
+			m.axis = int(v.left(-1)) as JoyAxis
+			m.axis_value = -1.0 if v.ends_with("-") else 1.0
+			return m
+	return null
+
+
+## The slot string for an input the player pressed ("" if it can't be bound).
+static func spec_of(ev: InputEvent) -> String:
+	if ev is InputEventKey and ev.pressed:
+		var code: int = ev.keycode if ev.keycode != KEY_NONE else ev.physical_keycode
+		if code == KEY_NONE or code in [KEY_SHIFT, KEY_CTRL, KEY_ALT, KEY_META]:
+			return ""   # (a modifier alone: wait for the key it goes with)
+		return "k:" + OS.get_keycode_string(code | (ev.get_modifiers_mask() as int))
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadButton and ev.pressed:
+		return "p:%d" % ev.button_index
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion and absf(ev.axis_value) > 0.6:
+		return "a:%d%s" % [ev.axis, "+" if ev.axis_value > 0.0 else "-"]
+	return ""
+
+
+const PAD_NAMES := {0: "A", 1: "B", 2: "X", 3: "Y", 4: "Back", 5: "Guide", 6: "Start", 7: "L3", 8: "R3",
+	9: "LB", 10: "RB", 11: "D-pad up", 12: "D-pad down", 13: "D-pad left", 14: "D-pad right"}
+const AXIS_NAMES := {"0-": "Left stick left", "0+": "Left stick right", "1-": "Left stick up", "1+": "Left stick down",
+	"2-": "Right stick left", "2+": "Right stick right", "3-": "Right stick up", "3+": "Right stick down", "4+": "LT", "5+": "RT"}
+
+
+## A slot as the player reads it ("W", "Enter", "RB", "RT"...).
+static func spec_text(spec: String) -> String:
+	if spec.length() < 3:
+		return ""
+	var v := spec.substr(2)
+	match spec[0]:
+		"k":
+			return v
+		"p":
+			return PAD_NAMES.get(int(v), "Button %s" % v)
+		"a":
+			return AXIS_NAMES.get(v, "Axis %s" % v)
+	return spec
+
+
+## "W / Up" - an action's keys (and pad, with `pad`), for hints and tooltips.
+func keys_text(id: String, pad := false) -> String:
+	var parts := []
+	for i in 3:
+		if i == 2 and not pad:
+			break
+		var t := spec_text(binds.get(id, ["", "", ""])[i])
+		if t != "":
+			parts.append(t)
+	return " / ".join(parts)
+
+
+## True on the press of `id` (no key repeat). A stick or trigger counts once
+## each time it's pushed past half way (it must come back first: its motion
+## events stream in all the while it's held).
+func pressed(ev: InputEvent, id: String) -> bool:
+	if not InputMap.has_action(id):
+		return false
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion:
+		return _axis_press(ev, id)
+	return ev.is_action_pressed(id, false, true)
+
+
+## The same, allowing key repeat (menu movement: hold to keep moving).
+func pressed_repeat(ev: InputEvent, id: String) -> bool:
+	if not InputMap.has_action(id):
+		return false
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion:
+		return _axis_press(ev, id)
+	return ev.is_action_pressed(id, true, true)
+
+
+## Like pressed_repeat, but held modifiers don't matter (Shift + a direction:
+## a bigger step).
+func pressed_loose(ev: InputEvent, id: String) -> bool:
+	if not InputMap.has_action(id):
+		return false
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion:
+		return _axis_press(ev, id)
+	return ev.is_action_pressed(id, true, false)
+
+
+var _latch := {}   # "<action>|<axis>" -> held past half way
+
+func _axis_press(ev: InputEventJoypadMotion, id: String) -> bool:
+	var key := "%s|%d" % [id, ev.axis]
+	for e in InputMap.action_get_events(id):
+		if e is InputEventJoypadMotion and e.axis == ev.axis:
+			if signf(e.axis_value) == signf(ev.axis_value) and absf(ev.axis_value) >= 0.5:
+				if _latch.get(key, false):
+					return false
+				_latch[key] = true
+				return true
+	return false
+
+
+## A stick or trigger back near the middle: it can count again (_axis_press).
+func _input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if ev is InputEventJoypadMotion and absf(ev.axis_value) < 0.35 and not _latch.is_empty():
+		var tail := "|%d" % ev.axis
+		for k in _latch:
+			if k.ends_with(tail):
+				_latch[k] = false
+
+
+## The 1-9 toolbar slot this event presses (-1: none).
+func slot_pressed(ev: InputEvent) -> int:
+	for i in 9:
+		if pressed(ev, "slot_%d" % (i + 1)):
+			return i
+	return -1
+
+
+## The left stick, past the dead zone (zero otherwise), on any pad.
+static func stick_vector() -> Vector2:
+	for dev in Input.get_connected_joypads():
+		var v := Vector2(Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X), Input.get_joy_axis(dev, JOY_AXIS_LEFT_Y))
+		if v.length() > DEADZONE:
+			return v.normalized() * inverse_lerp(DEADZONE, 1.0, minf(v.length(), 1.0))
+	return Vector2.ZERO
+
+
+static func pad_connected() -> bool:
+	return not Input.get_connected_joypads().is_empty()
+
+
+# --- Menu navigation ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A game menu (a Control) taking part in menu navigation while visible. It
+## may have cycle_tab(dir: int) for the tab actions.
+func register_menu(menu: Control) -> void:
+	if not menu in _menus:
+		_menus.append(menu)
+
+
+## The open game menu on top (the last registered one visible), or null.
+func active_menu() -> Control:
+	for i in range(_menus.size() - 1, -1, -1):
+		var m = _menus[i]
+		if not is_instance_valid(m):
+			_menus.remove_at(i)
+		elif m.is_visible_in_tree():
+			return m
+	return null
+
+
+func _unhandled_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if ev is InputEventMouse or (ev is InputEventKey and not ev.pressed):
+		return
+	var menu := active_menu()
+	if menu == null or UI.esc_menu_open():
+		return
+	var focus := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()
+	if focus is LineEdit or focus is TextEdit:
+		return
+	if pressed(ev, "menu_tab_prev") or pressed(ev, "menu_tab_next"):
+		if menu.has_method("cycle_tab"):
+			menu.cycle_tab(-1 if pressed(ev, "menu_tab_prev") else 1)
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+		return
+	var side := -1
+	for d in [["menu_up", SIDE_TOP], ["menu_down", SIDE_BOTTOM], ["menu_left", SIDE_LEFT], ["menu_right", SIDE_RIGHT]]:
+		if pressed_repeat(ev, d[0]):
+			side = d[1]
+	if side < 0:
+		return
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+	if focus == null or not menu.is_ancestor_of(focus) or not focus.is_visible_in_tree():
+		var first := first_focusable(menu)
+		if first:
+			first.grab_focus()
+		return
+	var next := focus.find_valid_focus_neighbor(side)
+	if next and next.is_visible_in_tree() and menu.is_ancestor_of(next):
+		next.grab_focus()
+
+
+## The first visible control in `root` that takes focus (depth first).
+static func first_focusable(root: Node) -> Control:
+	for c in root.get_children():
+		if c is Control and not c.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		if c is Control and c.focus_mode != Control.FOCUS_NONE and not (c is Button and c.disabled):
+			return c
+		var f := first_focusable(c)
+		if f:
+			return f
+	return null
